topics.known_state: City Developments (CDL) unveiled its GET+ strategic review on 28 Sep, outlining a plan to divest $6bn of assets and deploy $5bn of growth capital (also stated as S$6bn divestments and S$5bn growth capital) with new investments allocated 60% Singapore, 30% China, 10% Japan. The review targets divesting commercial and hospitality properties in the UK, China and Australia, exiting most of its Australian presence except hospitality, reducing net gearing from 75% to around 55%, generating over S$1bn PATMI from divestment gains, retaining about $5bn of core hotels, divesting roughly $1.8bn of non‑core hospitality assets, establishing a fund‑management entity to double AUM from $5bn (June 30) to S$10bn by FY2029, and shares fell >14% to $7.04 after the announcement.

topics.topic: Stoneweg Europe Stapled Trust internalisation proposal
topics.known_state: Stoneweg Europe Stapled Trust (SERT) proposed internalising its REIT manager and trustee‑manager, creating a unified platform with €3.2bn assets under management and expecting to lift distributions per stapled security by 5.9% to €0,1418 on an FY2025 pro forma basis.

topics.topic: MAS EQDP third batch allocation S$1.45bn
topics.known_state: The Monetary Authority of Singapore allocated S$1.45bn to five asset managers (Amundi, Franklin Templeton, HSBC Asset Management, M&G Investments, Natixis Investment Managers) under the third batch of its Equity Market Development Programme, bringing total EQDP allocations to S$5.4bn and including a S$20 million market‑making grant.

topics.topic: DFI Retail Group Maxim's stake sale and Starbucks control
topics.known_state: DFI Retail Group agreed to sell its 50% stake in the Maxim's‑branded restaurant chain to joint‑venture partner Hongkong Caterers for US$340 million in cash, while taking full control of roughly 1,100 Starbucks outlets across seven Asian territories; the reorganisation is expected to be completed by end‑March 2027.

topics.topic: Anthropic IPO prospectus valuation and financials
topics.known_state: Anthropic’s IPO prospectus projects 2025 revenue of nearly US$4.6 billion (a 12‑fold increase), a net loss of US$42 billion, and a potential listing valuation of over US$2 trillion.

topics.topic: IOI Properties Group acquisition of Shenton 101 and redevelopment plan
topics.known_state: IOI Properties Group (IOIPG) agreed to acquire Shenton 101 for $1, settling $217.6 million in shareholder advances and consolidating $376.23 million of borrowings, and plans a 35‑storey mixed‑use redevelopment with an estimated gross development value of $1.61 billion and redevelopment costs of about $973.65 million, targeted for completion in 4Q2026, subject to Bank Negara Malaysia approval, lender and Singapore Land Authority consents, and a waiver of a right of first refusal held by Multi Wealth (Singapore); Savills valued the site at $585 million as at Aug 15.

topics.topic: DFI Retail Group 1H2026 underlying profit and dividend
topics.known_state: DFI Retail Group reported underlying profit of US$117 million in 1H2026, an 11% YoY increase, free cash flow of US$382.7 million (down 9.3% YoY), and replaced its US$0,443 special dividend with a US$0,062 interim ordinary dividend.

topics.topic: UOL Group 1H2026 profit and free cash flow
topics.known_state: UOL Group reported profit before fair value gains and income tax of S$373.1 million in 1H2026, a 17% increase, and free cash flow of negative S$129.8 million driven by a S$298.1 million outflow for the Dorset Road site, lifting net gearing to 0.26 times.

topics.topic: SATS Q2 2026 revenue, profit and cash flow
topics.known_state: SATS posted revenue of S$1.7 billion for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, an 11.3% increase, net profit of S$75.1 million, a 6% rise, and negative free cash flow of S$22.6 million.

topics.topic: Metasurface Technologies Catalist dual listing filing
topics.known_state: Metasurface Technologies submitted a filing for a Catalist dual primary listing.

topics.topic: Deluge Fire Protection Mainboard listing order book $410.8m
topics.known_state: Deluge Fire Protection lodged a preliminary offer document for a Mainboard listing, indicating an order book of about $410.8 million.

topics.topic: SGX board lot size reduction to 10 units for 11 companies
topics.known_state: SGX will reduce the standard board lot size from 100 units to 10 units for 11 companies—including the three Singapore banks, Jardine Matheson and Keppel—effective 5 Oct.

topics.topic: Far East Orchard's 75% stake acquisition in Far East Hospitality Trust managers
topics.known_state: Far East Orchard will acquire an additional 42% stake in the two entities that manage Far East Hospitality Trust, raising its ownership to 75% and becoming the REIT’s main sponsor; the cash deal is valued at $28.3 million, will increase its assets under management by about 86% to $3.9 billion, is expected to deliver a 3.7% pro‑forma earnings‑per‑share accretion, does not require shareholder approval, and is slated to close by the end of 2026.

topics.topic: Cortina Holdings off‑market equal‑access share buyback
topics.known_state: Cortina Holdings completed an off‑market equal‑access buyback of 13,246,273 shares, representing 8 % of its issued capital, for S$54.97 million at S$4.15 per share.
Cortina Holdings reported FY26 revenue of S$979 million (+13.5 %) and profit after tax of S$72.4 million.

topics.topic: Chandra Asri Trading Company's acquisition of Hiap Seng Industries shares
topics.known_state: Chandra Asri Trading Company acquired 250.63 million shares in Hiap Seng Industries for S$2.76 million, raising its stake to 16.18 % and ending Tian Yuan’s substantial shareholding.

topics.topic: Hiap Seng Industries FY26 financial results
topics.known_state: Hiap Seng Industries posted FY26 revenue of S$24.4 million and a final dividend of S$0,0003 per share.

topics.topic: Weekly aggregate of listed company buybacks totalling S$47.8 million
topics.known_state: During the week, 26 listed companies carried out share buybacks amounting to S$47.8 million, with United Overseas Bank, Keppel and Singapore Telecommunications among the leading participants.
